scope: Stewart platform only; fresh graph compilation, kinematic assembly and dynamics probes; no new contact or closed-loop rollout
primary_claims_under_test: Physical graph compiles without manually authored tree/cut labels or closure/Jacobian functions
Physical spanning-tree lowering avoids the original artificial platform chart and reduces assembly dimensions
Graph-generated analytic derivatives avoid repeated finite-difference residual evaluations under matched SciPy correctors
Generated mappings preserve physical motion, reduced inertia, dynamics and power across data edits and tree choices
compiler_policy: Keep scalar and fixed joints first; choose first admissible spherical edge lexically; do not optimize the tree from timings
tree_sensitivity: All six possible spherical tree-edge choices, without selecting the fastest
timing: Single BLAS thread, randomized method order per case, initialization and independent validation excluded equally, all trials retained; compilation cost separate; warm result includes mapping
interpretation: Implementation-level observations, not a significance claim, general convergence theorem, hardware validation, real-time proof, or URDF+/generalized_rbda speed comparison
negative_controls: Explicit model/schema faults and omitted acceleration curvature are ablations, not competent external solver baselines
development: Protocol stored before production measurements; smoke debugging may fix software errors without selecting favorable targets or dropping failed methods
